units.source_text: 这时，我感到自己完全变成了化石。

en.t: At that moment, I felt that I had turned completely into a fossil.

units.source_text: 意志、欲望、所有的一切都石化了。

en.t: My will, my desires, everything had turned to stone.

units.source_text: 外界与我的内心世界无关，它再次坚定地存在于我的周围。

en.t: The outside world had nothing to do with my inner world; once again it existed firmly all around me.

units.source_text: 我穿着白色运动鞋，从叔父家里跑了出来，

en.t: Wearing white sneakers, I had run out of my uncle's house,

units.source_text: 沿着黎明前的黑暗的道路一直跑到这棵山毛榉后面，

en.t: and along the dark road before dawn I had run all the way behind this beech tree,

units.source_text: 我只不过是沿着自己内心世界的轨迹一个劲地"干吗！

en.t: I had merely been following the track of my own inner world, rushing on and on. "What are you doing!

units.source_text: 你这个结巴还恶作剧！"有为子说。

en.t: You stutterer, playing tricks again!" Uiko said.

units.source_text: 这声音里带有晨风的端庄和清爽。

en.t: Her voice held the dignity and freshness of the morning wind.

units.source_text: 她按过车铃，又骑上了自行车奔跑过来而已。

en.t: She had only rung her bicycle bell, mounted the bicycle again, and come riding toward me.

units.source_text: 隐约浮现在黎明前的黑暗中的村庄无数屋顶的轮廓、黑xuxu的树丛、长满嫩叶的黑压压的山顶，

en.t: The outlines of countless village roofs dimly emerging in the darkness before dawn, the dark clusters of trees, the black mountain peak thick with young leaves,

units.source_text: 连眼前的有为子，都变得毫无意义，甚至到了惊人的程度。

en.t: even Uiko before my eyes had become meaningless, to an astonishing degree.

units.source_text: 现实不等我的参与，早就赋予了。

en.t: Reality had not waited for my participation; it had long since been given.

units.source_text: 而且，这种毫无意义的巨大的黑暗现实，

en.t: And this immense, dark reality, utterly without meaning,

units.source_text: 以我迄今未曾见过的分量赋予了我，向我退将过来。

en.t: was given to me with a weight I had never seen before, and came pressing in upon me.
